beamline_seed.name: ALS Beamline 11.0.1.2
beamline_seed.definition: ALS Beamline 11.0.1.2, resonant soft X-ray scattering (RSoXS) with a reflectometer endstation. Source EPU5; photon energy 165–1,500 eV. ALS public range 165–1,500 eV. Blueprint beam note: ~200–1500 eV. Polarization is user selectable; linear polarization continuously variable from horizontal to vertical; left and right elliptical (or circular) polarization. Spot size = 100 μm diameter. Field of view/spatial resolution = down to 2 nm resolution. Sample information: Polymer thin films, solid thin films, vacuum compatible liquid cell. Other notes: High vacuum, heating. Flux 10 13 photons/s/0.1%BW at 800 eV; resolving power 4000 at 800 eV. Blueprint: BL 11.0.1.2 RSOXS · Reflectometer endstation · device blueprint (2026-09-09).
